parsed.post: Discarding the batch size increase (1.0475) as it regressed from my best (1.0182). It seems the larger batch size might be reducing the number of effective optimization steps within the 5-minute window. Reverting to e4b75ff. Next: I'll try a conservative LR increase to 0.07 on the D6/AR64 base.
parsed.description: Testing a moderate learning rate increase from 0.06 to 0.07 on the D6/AR64 base to find a better convergence point without the instability seen at 0.08.
